robot: Franka Emika Panda on a fixed mount with a two-finger gripper, absolute joint and finger position targets

frame.suite: VLABench's world frame (metres, z up; the robot faces +y, x to its right)
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: at the arm's mount, +X forward across the table (world +y), +Y the robot's left (world -x), +Z up

arm.note: Panda arm: 7 absolute joint position targets (rad); the gripper is the two finger openings (0.04 m each = open, 0 = closed), set together. There is no end-effector command; the hand pose is reported.

notes: The arm takes absolute joint position targets only: native action joint_position is 9 numbers, the 7 joints (rad) and then the two fingers' openings (m: 0 closed .. 0.04 open, set both alike); move_robot's gripper 0..1 sets both fingers. Nothing enforces the arm's joint limits: stay inside the Panda's own (spec_file: action_types.joint_position.panda_joint_limits_rad). The reported end-effector pose is the hand's tool point (tcp). A closed grasp holds the finger targets at 0: the fingers stop on the object, so the reported gripper value (the measured opening of one finger) stays below 1 while something is held. The cameras' intrinsics and poses (cam2world_gl, OpenGL axes, world frame) are in describe_robot's spec_file.
